threads.body:
Instead of unit testing this via `on_chat_model_start` against mocks, could we add an end-to-end integration test in `tests/test_llm_call.py`?

This mirrors the documented pattern from [LangSmith metadata parameters](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/ls-metadata-parameters#ls_model_name) for custom models and verifies that the span is actually emitted end-to-end with the expected attribute:

```python
def test_chat_model_uses_ls_model_name_from_metadata(
    span_exporter,
    tracer_provider,
):
    model = FakeMessagesListChatModel(responses=[AIMessage(content="Hello")])
    with instrument(LangChainInstrumentor(), tracer_provider=tracer_provider):
        model.invoke(
            [HumanMessage(content="Hi")],
            config={"metadata": {"ls_model_name": "my-custom-model"}},
        )

    (span,) = span_exporter.get_finished_spans()
    assert (
        span.attributes.get(gen_ai_attributes.GEN_AI_REQUEST_MODEL)
        == "my-custom-model"
    )
```
